items.title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it
items.description: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

items.title: Main Street Sports sues Comcast, Charter for underpaid licensing fees
items.description: Main Street has been in the process of winding down its portfolio of regional sports networks since the the NHL and NBA seasons ended earlier this year.

items.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
items.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027.

items.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global hires Goldman veteran Markowitz as top lawyer amid probe of insurers
items.description: Federal authorities are investigating how two insurers that are part of Mark Walter's business empire classified more than $20 billion in loans to his companies.

items.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Robots need help learning human skills. These AI companies are rushing to meet the demand
items.description: Humanoid robots still take a long time to complete human tasks. Several startups in China are trying different ways to collect and use training data better.

items.title: Los Angeles Lakers worth 'every bit' of $12.5 billion price tag: 76ers and Commanders owner Josh Harris
items.description: The Los Angeles Lakers set a new record for a professional team sale price at $12.5 billion, and sports investor Josh Harris said the team is worth "every bit."

items.title: Here's what Jim Cramer says stock investors need to know about the bond market
items.description: Cramer said investors should watch long-term Treasury yields, which have surged amid inflation concerns, government borrowing and AI-related corporate debt issuances.

items.title: A media M&A chill: The Paramount-WBD antitrust challenge may hold up more deals than one
items.description: Paramount's proposed merger with WBD is delayed while an antitrust lawsuit plays out. The holdup could mean a freeze across the media industry.

items.title: California AG Rob Bonta cancels Paramount settlement meeting, citing 'lack of good faith'
items.description: California AG Rob Bonta was scheduled to meet with Paramount representatives on Monday, he said, but canceled the meeting.

items.title: Supreme Court allows some Trump vote-by-mail limits ahead of midterm election
items.description: The unsigned order lifted an injunction covering 23 states and Washington, D.C.; the court’s three liberal justices dissented.

items.title: Trump’s oil and gas stocks gained up to $15.5 million amid Iran war, congressional Democrats say
items.description: Trump’s stock trading could face heightened congressional scrutiny if Democrats retake either chamber in the midterms.

items.title: Yields decline on CNBC report Treasury could use General Account to fund buybacks
items.description: Treasury yields fell Monday as investors await Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's keynote speech at Jackson Hole later this week.

items.title: Jim Cramer says don't sell Meta on litigation risk — the stock is worth the wait
items.description: Meta's court battles are an overhang on the stock, but its business fundamentals make it one worth holding.

items.title: Crypto extends gains after biggest 3-day rally since 2023
items.description: Bitcoin and crypto stocks extended their rally after the flagship cryptocurrency broke out of its trading range.

items.title: A massive trade just happened in gold. The options market is buzzing
items.description: Twenty minutes after the market opened Monday, someone sold almost 116,000 420-strike calls in the SPDR Gold Shares ETF (GLD) expiring Sept. 18.

items.title: Prediction market traders doubtful Bessent’s bond interventions will push yields lower
items.description: Speculators still see yields hitting new highs in 2026 and ending the year at levels elevated from where they're currently trading.

items.title: Trump admin unveils anti-Iran global sanctions plan, signals China not exempt
items.description: The Trump administration unveiled a plan to isolate Iran's economy by threatening to impose secondary sanctions on the Islamic Republic's "enablers."

items.title: Trump Media CEO defends selling faster access to president's Truth Social posts, says more have signed up
items.description: Trump Media interim CEO Kevin McGurn defended his company offering faster access to President Donald Trump's Truth Social posts.

items.title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
items.description: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.

items.title: U.S. Trade Rep Greer blames Canada for failed tariff talks: 'They wanted more'
items.description: Canadian negotiators left Washington on Friday without a deal to prevent President Trump from enacting new 50% tariffs on about $20 billion worth of goods.
